blocks.text: Step-by-step guide.
Generate the CSR with a 2048-bit key.
Send the CSR to the internal authority via pki.example.test.
Download the certificate and the intermediate chain.
Install the certificate on web01.example.test and restart the web service.
Check the expiry date with the command openssl x509 -noout -enddate -in server.crt.

text:
Step-by-step guide.
1. Generate the CSR with a 2048-bit key.
2. Send the CSR to the internal authority via pki.example.test.
3. Download the certificate and the intermediate chain.
4. Install the certificate on web01.example.test and restart the web service.
5. Check the expiry date with the command openssl x509 -noout -enddate -in server.crt.
